assertions: Asks which workspace (b2b, personal, or both) before mutating
Calls get_active_workspace_info as availability check
Uses add_domain_to_blocklist (not add_email_to_blocklist) for domain-level blocking
Reports the workspace(s) and timestamp
Does not reference Smartlead, Instantly, or Apollo

Should name campaign-orchestration as the target sibling skill. Should carry workspace context forward if workspace was already confirmed. Should NOT attempt to write sequence content or call create_sequence_steps directly.
assertions: Identifies request as campaign-orchestration's scope
Names campaign-orchestration explicitly as the handoff target
Does not call create_sequence_steps or write sequence content
Carries workspace context forward if already established

assertions: Confirms target workspace
Calls get_active_workspace_info
Verifies URL is not OutboundSync before proceeding
Calls list_webhooks and create_webhook (not external tooling)

evals.prompt: Subscribe our brite-data-platform OutboundSync endpoint to Email Bison reply events so our Salesforce contacts update in real time. URL: https://sync.brite-data-platform.internal/emailbison/events
evals.expected_output: Should detect that the URL pattern-matches OutboundSync (brite-data-platform host, /emailbison/events path) and STOP before creating the webhook. Should warn about the double-subscription gotcha — OutboundSync owns the canonical CRM-sync path; having this skill subscribe the same endpoint directly creates dedup headaches. Should point the user at OutboundSync's own webhook configuration rather than create a parallel subscription here. Should cite email-bison.md §Known gotchas bullet 4 as the source of the rule.
assertions: Detects URL matches OutboundSync pattern
Stops before calling create_webhook
Warns about the double-subscription gotcha
References email-bison.md §Known gotchas or §Related skills for OutboundSync ownership
Points the user at OutboundSync configuration rather than create a parallel subscription
